mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical Klinger Volume Oscillator crossing of its trigger identifies a reversal in price-conditioned volume force; follow the crossover direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when KVO crosses strictly above its signal; short on the strict reverse crossover
mechanism.why_distinct: KVO recursively accumulates range conditional on H+L+C trend, converts volume into signed volume force, and compares EMA(34) with EMA(55) against an EMA(13) trigger. It is not a price-average cross, prior candidate repair, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour price-conditioned volume-force trigger crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T), including base volume
features.trend: +1 iff current H+L+C exceeds prior completed value, otherwise -1
features.dm_cm: dm=high-low; cm=prior cm+dm when trend unchanged, otherwise prior dm+dm
features.volume_force: volume*abs(2*(dm/cm)-1)*trend*100, finite with strict positive cm
features.kvo: causal EMA(34) volume force minus causal EMA(55) volume force
features.event: current KVO-trigger difference strictly changes nonzero sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Klinger Volume Oscillator 34/55/13 trigger crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no EMA period, volume-force formula, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Stephen Klinger canonical Volume Oscillator convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: trend sign from H+L+C; dm=H-L; cm accumulates dm while trend persists and resets to prior dm+current dm on reversal; VF=volume*abs(2*(dm/cm)-1)*trend*100; KVO=EMA34(VF)-EMA55(VF); EMA13 trigger
external_basis.selection_use: published 34/55/13 formula and signal crossover direction only; no incidence or outcomes
